metadata.body:
# PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

Blueprint for clio-agent. The numeric work lives in plain scripts in this
repository so it can run on PBS compute nodes without an LLM:

- `agent/manifest.py`: list the DASV records on `s3://nrel-pds-porotomo/` and sample them.
- `agent/detect.py`: per-record detector (common-mode removal, 10-150 Hz band-pass, median STA/LTA).
- `agent/pbs/submit.sh`: submit the distributed detection plus aggregation job to Aurora.
- `agent/hazard.py`: anomaly z-scores, event catalogue, pumping volumes, seismogenic index, probabilities.

The experts orchestrate those scripts, inspect files, and explain results. They
never make up numbers. Every figure they report comes from `summary.json` or a
tool result.

Install by linking this directory into `~/.config/clio-agent/agent-blueprints/`.

2. /crs — shape () (scalar), dtype uint8 (contiguous).
3. /das — shape (30000, 384), dtype float32, chunked with chunk shape (2000, 384). Main DAS waveform array: 30,000 time samples × 384 channels.
4. /t — shape (30000,), dtype float64, chunked (30000,). Time axis with attribute units = "seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"; constant 0.001 s step → 1000 Hz (1 kHz) sample rate.
5. /trace — shape (30000,), dtype int64, chunked (30000,). Trace/sample index (0, 1, 2, ...).
6. /x — shape (384,), dtype float32 (contiguous). Receiver x-coordinates; NaN-filled (not populated) in this record.
7. /y — shape (384,), dtype float32 (contiguous). NaN-filled.
8. /z — shape (384,), dtype float32 (contiguous). NaN-filled.

Summary: native PoroTomo DAS record with 30,000 samples @ 1000 Hz across 384 channels — float32 /das chunked (2000×384), float64 /t epoch-seconds, int64 /trace, int32 /channel, scalar uint8 /crs, and NaN-filled float32 geometry arrays /x, /y, /z. These 8 datasets are the complete contents of the file.
